original_olson_2014_double_source: historical Olson 2014 single/double mutant table; not the Wu 2016 four-site previously consumed WSP-196 sample
source_access_method: GitHub Git blob API via read-only connected GitHub integration. Direct raw URL and ordinary GitHub file fetch failed for the 21.7MB table; Git blob endpoint supplied full original text.
integrity_method: All four original Git blob SHA-1 digests recomputed independently over ASCII source bytes using SHA1('blob '+len+'\0'+contents); all matched pinned upstream Git object IDs. Independently computed SHA-256 over the same bytes.
original_line_ending: Original TSV records separated with lone carriage returns (CR, U+000D), not LF/CRLF. Original FASTA uses LF. Python universal-newline reader uses newline='' and accepts CR.
metadata_checks: All four original byte identities exact
WT reference allele matches FASTA at source position
Every alternate is one of 20 standard amino acids and differs from WT
Unordered double mutants canonicalized for duplicate detection
No duplicate single or double genotype identities
Original table widths match 5 and 18 fields
Single and double source rosters both nonempty
metadata_validator: Independent JS metadata-only verifier equivalent to committed Python checker core genotype semantics; not the Python original-source execution. Parses tab fields as strings; does not numerically interpret count, selection or fitness columns.

limitations.source_data_license: Underlying data reuse/redistribution rights not independently verified. Repo code is MIT; no original measurements redistributed.
limitations.no_scientific_prereg: A new prospective WSP-198 comparator and held protocol still required before any observed counts/fitness values are used.
